title: Zakat
intro: An estimate of the zakat on your trade goods: the figures the software knows, plus what you add.
belowNisab: The base is below the nisab: no zakat is due.
disclaimer: An indicative calculation made by the software. It is not a fatwa; when in doubt, ask a scholar or your wilaya's religious affairs directorate.
savedEmpty: No saved calculation. Save today's to keep and print it.
printed: Zakat calculation sent to the printer.
mainPcOnly: Calculations are saved and kept on the main PC.
